Does waking at 5 a.m. make you more productive? No study has tested the habit itself. Morning people do a little better on average, mostly when their schedule fits their body clock.

The 5 AM Club itself says sleep 7.5 hours, so a 5 a.m. alarm means asleep by 9:30. People who start work by 6 a.m. average about 6 hours.

Sources: Basner 2014 (Sleep), Preckel 2011, Facer-Childs 2019 (Sleep Med).
